name: memolens
description: Start path-free native Library setup, navigate private media evidence, and use one shared Browser editor for canonical edits, video Split, occurrence Remove, history, and append-only restore.

interface.shortDescription: Your private creator library, ready to shape a story.
interface.longDescription: MemoLens gives Codex a local-first path from an unconfigured host to a canonical editing surface. Its path-free Library bootstrap tools queue only a bounded local intent; they never accept a folder or database path, and Electron's native chooser remains the sole source of filesystem authority. A staged result is not yet a Core Library, scan, project, Blueprint, or editor. A committed result creates the exact Core Library/database, deterministic project, minimal unverified Blueprint, and one queued resumable scan; use memolens_status and inspect database.library_scan for its path-free progress. Scan completion still does not make the editor ready. Once separately grounded Coverage, a canonical Timeline, and an active project pairing exist, Codex can read confirmed preferences, navigate a live media Wiki, resume the exact persisted Creative Blueprint proposal, and open one canonical Timeline editor by project ID in Codex's in-app Browser. The graphical editor provides a ruler, scrub playhead, zoom, verified same-session thumbnails, drag reorder, trim handles, video Split at playhead, and Remove clip from Timeline. The original controls require timeline.apply_edit; Split and Remove require the independent timeline.apply_structural_edit action and one exact top-level structural_edit. Split uses absolute source time, at least 100 ms per child, and a 256-clip cap. Remove changes only the Timeline occurrence and leaves original media unchanged. With separately approved timeline.preview_media, supported MP4/H.264 clips can play through a verified source-preview proxy. Raw MP4 transport may contain audio, while the page disables audio playback and keeps output muted; audio-stream presence, content, and mix are not attested, and this is not transition, render, export, or final-fidelity proof. The plugin derives and cross-checks Blueprint, Coverage, current Timeline N, read-only historical K, fixed-source, and same-Beat replacement state. Stage remains noncanonical; explicit Save appends one ordinary edit, structural edit, or K-as-N+1 restore only after its separately scoped action, exact CAS, and canonical reread. Pairing secrets and desktop/main tokens stay server-side. The separate Unsaved Draft Lab retains its broader Timeline 1.0 experiments as Not saved and process-scoped. Desktop/Electron remains native authority, pairing approval/revoke, runtime management, and a Timeline-v2-compatible reader, not the primary editing interface.
capabilities: Path-free native Library bootstrap intent and status
Graphical ruler, playhead, zoom, drag and trim controls
Video Split and Timeline-occurrence Remove controls
Native-approved source preview with muted output
defaultPrompt: If MemoLens has no confirmed Library, start path-free setup; otherwise show its media Wiki and follow the best idea to evidence.
Resume my latest MemoLens project, read its canonical Blueprint proposal, and show what remains unresolved.
Open the MemoLens Canonical Editor to split a video, remove one occurrence without deleting its source, or restore a revision.
